title: quenched syrian double-fried chicken burger
description: a unique syrian twist on a classic burger, with the added crunch of double-fried chicken and a hint of speculaas spice mix.
instructions: in a shallow dish, mix together flour, speculaas spice mix, and a pinch of salt.
dredge each chicken piece in the flour mixture, shaking off excess.
dip the floured chicken in the beaten eggs, making sure they're fully coated.
dredge the egg-coated chicken in the flour mixture again, pressing the coating onto the meat to adhere.
heat 1 inch of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
fry 2 chicken pieces at a time until golden brown, about 5-6 minutes.
drain the fried chicken on paper towels and repeat with the remaining chicken pieces.
assemble the burgers by spreading a layer of mayonnaise on the bottom bun, followed by a chicken piece, a lettuce leaf, a tomato slice, a pickle slice, and finally the top bun.
place the assembled burgers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 10-12 minutes or until the cheese is melted and the buns are toasted.
quench the burgers with a dollop of tzatziki sauce, if desired.
